integrity: The all-dimensional statement is proved analytically. Exact cyclotomic computation is included only as a finite corroborative check of the local nine-point geometry.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to four-point affine parallelogram supports in ternary vector spaces with all four coefficients nonzero; it does not classify arbitrary four-point supports or coefficient orbits.
title: Exact Fourier-support spectrum on ternary affine parallelograms
